CustomField.description: Expiry of the Installateurverzeichnis entry. Capped at five years with no automatic renewal (BDEW/ZVEH Grundsätze §5.1); §5.2 says the firm should be notified three months before expiry, which is where the reminder window comes from. Once it lapses the partner may not legally perform the installation.
CustomField.label: Installateurverzeichnis gültig bis
